cohort: The study participants included 1687 individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASDG) and 466 control individuals (CG) who completed questionnaires about their environmental factors and health conditions.
finding: Gastrointestinal problems escalate as individuals age and are significantly more prominent in individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder than in controls.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery did not appear to be a determining factor for gastrointestinal problems in the ASD group but was relevant for the control group, with significant differences in breastfeeding status compared to GPs among preterm control individuals born via cesarean section.
gest_age: The study included preterm control individuals, but specific gestational age ranges for the overall cohort were not mentioned.
